slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: SEC EDGAR filings: 10 randomly chosen ladder and RPO numbers re-opened at their cited pages by a second reader.
An independent GPU rental price index or second marketplace: direction agreement with the logged median over the window.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 9. Proof. How you know it worked. SEC EDGAR filings: 10 randomly chosen ladder and RPO numbers re-opened at their cited pages by a second reader. An independent GPU rental price index or second marketplace: direction agreement with the logged median over the window.

slides.heading: Minimum-price bias
paras: logged H100 price is far below what any real renter pays.
store median and p25 of verified on-demand offers and flag list-price sources.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 8 of 9. Biggest failure mode. Minimum-price bias. Tell: logged H100 price is far below what any real renter pays. Fix: store median and p25 of verified on-demand offers and flag list-price sources.
